findings.certainty: source chain plus historical actual callback counts
findings.trigger: Whisper onProgress -> renderTurnStatus -> renderQuestionSummary, on every download chunk
findings.suggestion: App owner may coalesce download UI rendering to one update per 100–200ms, keeping final/error/owner handling immediate; visible/incremental summary separately removes full reconstruction.

findings.certainty: architecture verified; current long-task magnitude unmeasured
findings.facts: Bridge imports Transformers.js 3.8.1 in window, explicitly selects wasm, sets no proxy/Worker. Upstream 3.8.1 ONNX backend defaults wasm.proxy=false and exposes env.backends.onnx. Promise/await does not move execution off the page context.
findings.candidate: A future minimal candidate can enable env.backends.onnx.wasm.proxy before pipeline initialization, with real browser engine/model tests. Do not blindly switch this in a release without regression.

findings.certainty: source plus historical actual loader records
findings.facts: Only 12 completed-file callbacks repaint; 11 stage callbacks are ignored. This is bounded and not comparable to Whisper per-download-chunk storm.

Native AudioBuffer path uses one OfflineAudioContext downmix/resample. Main JS still scans/copies PCM; fallback JS downmix is only for non-native test buffers. No measured proof this dominates current lag.
